descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S13 Switching care setting, deep links and reload: each dashboard lists only its own patient, with no junk and no stuck loading

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture: the resident has no unit stored; the Hospital patient has a room

When Open the Hospital dashboard; go back, switch to Nursing Home, open its dashboard; go back, switch to Hospital, open its dashboard again. Then navigate straight to /snf/dashboard and reload; navigate straight to /rounding/dashboard and reload

Then Each dashboard lists only its own care setting's patient, every time, with no leftover from the previous screen. After each reload it loads its own patient again. No blank screen, no stuck loading or 'being updated' text, and no 'undefined', 'null' or 'NaN' where the unit is missing. Total 1 on each once the counts check lands

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: every checkpoint mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' (the url check is a no-op, runnerNotes.url) and its own patient, and mustNotContain the other care setting's patient, 'Loading rounding status' and 'being updated'. The two reload checkpoints also mustNotContain 'undefined', 'null' and 'NaN'. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S13

Switching care setting, deep links and reload: each dashboard lists only its own patient, with no junk and no stuck loading

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 20/20. Hospital -> Nursing Home -> Hospital through the list toggle and each list's Dashboard control, then /snf/dashboard + reload and /rounding/dashboard + reload: each of the 5 checkpoints lists only its own patient, Total 1, no stuck loading or 'being updated', and the resident with no unit shows '0 tasks pending' (no 'undefined' / 'null' / 'NaN').

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: ticket-gate — ticket-gate: TFA-92598 in progress — requirements U1, U2 gated (runnable on dev otherwise). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
